metadata.charcoalProvenance: Approved charcoal surfaces remain unchanged. All 73 primitive values match DESIGN.md and CSS. Dark brand pink and chart-1 match corresponding light roles; light primitives, body text, status and chart-2..5 remain unchanged. Chromium foreground checks passed at light/dark 320/390/1280.
metadata.focusPaint: Semantic alias outside primitive declarations: light var(--ring), dark var(--foreground). Explicit focus classes opt in; opaque destructive invalid focus retains priority. Dark selected calendar graphics use existing neutral foreground because exact brand pink is 2.986:1 on #292929. No threshold rounding or new primitive pair.
metadata.tonalRampProvenance: Generated preview only: eight stepped lightness values with source chroma, hue, and alpha preserved. Not normative project colors; browser gamut mapping may affect appearance.
metadata.darkPreview: Tokens and focus alias inherit through shadow DOM. Set data-theme="dark" on outline/ghost buttons and inputs for explicit dark-only overrides, and on Sidebar Navigation for neutral active labels. Light literals are fallbacks only. Focus preview uses the inherited semantic alias, not a brand-token override.
metadata.shellLayout: Headerless authenticated shell: borderless rounded desktop sidebar inset 24px, with independently scrolling navigation above a non-shrinking footer and search/read-only status above the bottom account row. Theme and language remain exclusively on the existing Settings page. The mobile navigation Sheet also has no right border. Mobile uses an ordinary-flow Open menu trigger and the same footer in the left Sheet. Sidebar Navigation previews the inset frame and utility-before-account order, not functional shell interactions.

narrative.overview:
The Measurement Ledger describes the incumbent kankaku-hub dashboard, not a new product brand. Its mood is discreet, precise, and legible: measurements and their reporting context lead, while pink provides a recognizable signal on neutral ground.

Soft and precise components sit in discreet functional layers. Tonal separation carries flat surface hierarchy; control borders and table dividers retain functional boundaries without decorative shadows. Compact tables coexist with more open summary and catalog cards without forcing one density onto every surface.
keyCharacteristics: Pink signal on neutral ground in light and dark themes.
Soft and precise controls; discreet functional layers.

rules.name: The Semantic Pair Rule
rules.body: Use semantic foreground/background pairs from the active theme; chart identity and measurement status are separate meanings.

dos: Do preserve paired light/dark semantic foregrounds, status meanings, and visible keyboard focus.
Do keep measurement columns tabular and preserve the existing compact table spacing.
Do preserve localized wrapping and Japanese paragraph breathing room.
donts: Don't substitute chart-series colors for status semantics.
Don't replace measurement-table default gutters with full-bleed padding overrides or duplicate those gutters inside the table.
Don't describe missing or uncertain measurements as confirmed zero.
